worked_solution:
We wish to find the limits of integration such that our integral can be expressed as

$$
{\int }_{a}^{b}{\int }_{{v}_{1}(z)}^{{v}_{2}(z)}{\int }_{{u}_{1}(y,z)}^{{u}_{2}(y,z)}f(x,y,z)\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}z.
$$

From the repeated integrals, we see that the domain of integration $R={R}_{1}\cup {R}_{2},$ where ${R}_{1}$ and ${R}_{2}$ are type I regions, is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}{R}_{1} & ={(x,y,z)\,:\,-2\le y\le 2,\,\,0\le z\le \sqrt{y+2},\,\,-z\le x\le {y}^{2}}, \\ {R}_{2} & ={(x,y,z)\,:\,2\le y\le 6,\,\,0\le z\le \sqrt{6-y},\,\,-z\le x\le {y}^{2}}.\end{aligned}
$$

Since all repeated integrals first integrate with respect to $x,$ the $x$-limits remain the same as before:

$$
{\int }_{a}^{b}{\int }_{{v}_{1}(z)}^{{v}_{2}(z)}{\int }_{-z}^{{y}^{2}}f(x,y,z)\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}z
$$

 

Now, we consider the projection $D$ of $R$ onto the $yz$-plane shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14072974/assets/aa1c884900c3cb01a719dc6d22604469984d2b08291d9d925b8f37d794d455b2.png)

The region $D$ consists of two type I regions in the $yz$-plane:

$$
D={(y,z)\,:\,-2\le y\le 2,\,0\le z\le \sqrt{y+2}}\,\cup \,{(y,z)\,:\,2\le x\le 6,\,0\le z\le \sqrt{6-y}}.
$$

To change the order of integration from $\text{d}x\,\text{d}z\,\text{d}y$ to $\text{d}x\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}z,$ we write $D$ as a type II region.

Notice that the left boundary of the region, written in the form $y=y(z),$ is

$$
z=\sqrt{y+2}\,⟹\,y={z}^{2}-2
$$

and the right boundary of the region is

$$
z=\sqrt{6-y}\,⟹\,y=6-{z}^{2}.
$$

Then, the type II representation of the region is

$$
D={(y,z)\,:\,0\le z\le 2,\,{z}^{2}-2\le y\le 6-{z}^{2}},
$$

as shown in the diagram below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14072974/assets/e4139dde4d56e83b91e4a72d42ccdf296ad20773520ccdaa51d7a84b9e1a3f31.png)

Therefore, by swapping the order of integration, we obtain

$$
{\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{{z}^{2}-2}^{6-{z}^{2}}{\int }_{-z}^{{y}^{2}}f(x,y,z)\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}z.
$$
